answer: Work history locks for 30 days before it can be spent, and any answer inside one grade of a tie goes back to a second panel, so a contested seat waits twice and its recruiter cannot audit it. A maintainer reading this later should know the lock is 30 days, not 30 epochs. A farm of 150 seats parks 150 histories for a month and pays 150 stakes for the second panel, roughly 6,000 POA. The pearl is the record that survives the lock, a glacier is the wait, and a sonnet of praise buys neither.
